snippet.title: Alkimya: House of Wisdom - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Alkimya: House of Wisdom | Announcement Trailer

Baghdad, 1258. The Mongol army is at the walls, and the House of Wisdom holds a secret older than the city. Alkimya is a first-person survival horror game set in the final days of the Islamic Golden Age.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4829820
Coming to PS5 and PC. Release date TBA.
